## What it is

Temporary flat plate with the outline of the combined board
(`pcb/combined/combined.kicad_pcb`, Edge.Cuts) grown by the enclosure wall on
every side. It is printed to check that the board and its enclosure fit in the
machine, around the needle pressure gauge (south-east) and the boiler SSR
(north-west). boitier_ac and boitier_dc will replace it as the real enclosure.

## Design notes

- The outline is copied from the KiCad Edge.Cuts polygon (124.8 × 87.6 mm),
  with KiCad's Y flipped so north is up, and the south-west corner at the
  origin. If the board outline changes, update `_BOARD_OUTLINE_KICAD`.
- `wall_around` = 1.68 mm, the enclosure wall; the outer corners stay sharp
  (`offset_in` with a negative distance), so the plate is the worst-case
  footprint.
- 1.6 mm thick, like the PCB.

## Don't

- No holes, connectors or components: this is only a footprint check.
- No polish pass: David asked for sharp edges on this plate.
